title: Sign in to the correct workspace
summary: Use your own account and enter the business your role can access.

sections.title: Sign in
sections.body:
1. Select **Sign in** on the ClipperDesk website.
2. Enter your email and password, then select **Sign in**. If Google sign-in is offered for your account, you can choose that option.
3. Complete the authenticator or recovery-code challenge if your account requires it.
4. Open your business workspace. If you have access to several, choose the intended business.
5. Check the business identity before making changes.

sections.title: Joining an existing business
sections.body: Open the invitation sent by your business instead of registering a new owner workspace. You must accept it with the exact invited email. Your owner controls the role and locations you can access.

sections.title: If access fails
sections.body: Use **Forgot password?** for a password you cannot remember. If your email needs verification, follow the email-verification screen. If your login was disabled, ask the business owner to review access. If Google returns a different email, sign out and choose the correct account. Never share passwords, authenticator codes or invitation links with another team member.
